summary: Zone Frontier Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that a subsidiary entered a Ground Lease with GKC Operating, LLC effective September 24, 2026, covering roughly 4,077 acres in Potter County, Texas for a West Texas data center campus developed with HST Technologies. Terms include a 30-year initial term plus two 10-year options, base rent of $6,000 per acre annually for the data center area and $1,000 for the solar area, CPI escalation, a 0.5% revenue share, and a purchase option at $100,000 per acre. This is an operational real estate contract, not a special situation; watch construction timing and financing.
